## Useful documents for Report 1

- Here are two examples: [template1](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497683?verifier=2QhUqC7cYbc1YbSz4zmxGbc7TJTvBlTIfmYswI39&wrap=1) and [template2](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497679?verifier=IMH3OLZpMF5LPVd5o38Ks0jYYHqX5tOeCl6sceNq&wrap=1) for Excel group data collection. Generate and complete your group's own Excel file (could be from a Google Sheets file) **before** Week 8 prac.
- Here is a [guide to choosing appropriate stats](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497621?verifier=31SiT2YIAQJiBmBVtQjnpnuMOHZJN7RjHGFFlz6y&wrap=1) and a [guide to using the stats program SPSS](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497622?verifier=mimwbS9VubCDJYIxfwYYFXhMilGhUc4CuXXGm0Vx&wrap=1).
- Practice Excel file for [ANOVA or Randomised Block design/GLM](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497665?verifier=MTZmp057C5nuK9AUhVr866FaPVMzVsagE0UTbGG2&wrap=1) and [associated paper](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497670?verifier=h0HOnl7J7MSp4jqwSTbrp6880Z038HmiwnEdiJUO&wrap=1).
- Practice Excel file for [linear regression (or correlation)](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497666?verifier=W84A0SbM0TcDc4Zmytwf9mmIwl2rya8Xfnd8Cl5e&wrap=1) and [associated paper](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497667?verifier=941JP62VCoqgBYuppwkqkc2puY4NPBTKmGeIXrDr&wrap=1).
- Practice Excel file for [logistic regression](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497653?verifier=gs7lQoyM2osy95YNrlvWIla2FFmr0NiBZs3zBfhg&wrap=1) and [associated paper](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50496897?verifier=tKcaSo2GfbWv7ozC1lAl9ccdvBH1s34xuVeW9ELV&wrap=1).
- And an interesting article called "[The importance of stupidity in scientific research](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497659?verifier=oZwJUnLtJJRSfLI0byFhd3nuUZqZutGSF3x3otyw&wrap=1)": directed at PhD students but also, I think, relevant to our Module projects where you take a step into the unknown. Hope you enjoy it.



## BIRD GROUPS ONLY
::: callout-important
## Important Animal Ethics information
Please read the [2026 Animal Research Authority (ARA)](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/52111463) and use the [2026 Bird survey monitoring sheet (PDF)](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/52106044) for your data collection. For spreadsheet editing, use the [editable monitoring-sheet template (XLSX)](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/50497669).

As part of the Animal Ethics requirements each bird group must submit:

1. at least one example of this completed monitoring sheet, along with
2. a pdf document summarising (a) the sites visited (names with  suburb, and if possible GPS coords and site photos),
 and (b) the total number of (i) native birds and (ii) invasive birds you estimate you have counted across all your sites.

:::
